61394.commentary: (MNa) sahadhammikesū'ti niyyānikasāsane sahadhammikesu piyamanāpatā'pi sammaggatā hoti, mahāsampattiṃ āvahati.

examples.text: atthi kho no, āvuso, satthari pasādo, atthi dhamme pasādo, atthi sīlesu paripūrakāritā, sahadhammikā kho pana piyā manāpā, gahaṭṭhā c'eva pabbajitā ca.

61395.meaning1: rule about (being spoken to) legitimately; Pācittiya 71

61396.meaning1: Section 8 of the monk's offences requiring confession

61397.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sahadhammika
61397.construction:
saha + dhamma + ika + aṃ
sahadhammika + aṃ
61397.commentary: (VIN 1.2.12) sahadhammikaṃ nāma yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.

examples.text: bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ, āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi, yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

61398.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of sahadhamma
61398.commentary: (VINa) vadatu sahadhammenā'ti sahadhammikena sikkhāpadena sahadhammena vā aññena'pi pāsādikabhāvasaṃvattanikena vacanena vadatu.

examples.text: m'āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi, vacanīyam'ev'āyasmā attānaṃ karotu, āyasmā'pi bhikkhū vadatu sahadhammena, bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.
